# Monitoring after go-live (generated by `make monitor`)

Live model: the validated scorecard (36-month loans issued 2007-2014 (337,996 loans)). Every 36-month application from 2015 Q1 is scored. Traffic light for PSI / CSI: below 0.1 green, 0.1-0.25 amber, 0.25 or more red.
